title: The Chemistry Workbench's engines
about: The plug-ins' C++ on the foundations (morphe's graph rewriting, algebra and topology; physis's point groups, stranded field theories and reaction kinetics; calx's integrators and random streams), compiled with g++ 11 or later, natively or in WSL, into data/cache/engines/chemistry/. A minute or two; compiled again when a source changes.
